{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
if df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum() > 0:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = real_orders[real_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
num_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = num_converted / total_loyal

# Output the result
print(f"Number of loyal customers (real orders): {total_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_fraction"}
